ownership: Native ports capture render session/epoch/definition/protocol/versions/randomSeed and hook generation; old port never adopts later stateRef session.
load/restart start and effect cleanup invalidate old generation; setup reactivates current lifecycle, including StrictMode setup-cleanup-setup.
Every relevant native await checks current generation before advancing UI or issuing another action; old in-flight write may finish only against original expected identity.

Optional expected identity compares draftKey/instrument/session/epoch/definition/submission inside Memory operation or the same IDB META/TRIAL write transaction for put/seal/status/delete. Legacy callers omit it.
Raw seal and core finish carry original expected identity through get/mutate/status/delete; sealed-load replay onRetry/catch are also current-load/expected guarded.
Already-issued server FINAL is not cancelled; it may commit for its original identity. A late response cannot change new local metadata or UI.
Actual device/input provenance remains in the sealed FINAL payload; native skips separate unguarded metadata write.
